name: Augusta
address: 2 Protea Ln, Kleinkrantz, Wilderness, 6560, South Africa
description_short: Relaxed Wilderness eatery serving hearty breakfasts and comfort food near pristine Garden Route beaches.
description_long:
Tucked away in the peaceful Kleinkrantz area of Wilderness, Augusta offers a welcoming escape for locals and visitors seeking honest, satisfying meals. The relaxed atmosphere makes it an easy choice for leisurely breakfasts or casual lunches after a morning on the beach.

The menu focuses on well-executed comfort food, with generous breakfast plates and hearty mains that hit the spot without pretension. It's the kind of place where you can settle in with good coffee and enjoy the unhurried Garden Route pace.

Located just minutes from Wilderness's famous beaches and lagoon, Augusta serves as a convenient pit stop whether you're exploring the area's trails or simply soaking up the coastal scenery. The straightforward approach and friendly service make it a reliable choice for families and groups.
